West Bengal to Abolish Madrasah Service Commission, Merge Functions

The West Bengal government is planning to abolish the Madrasah Service Commission and merge its functions with the West Bengal School Service Commission (WBSSC). This move aims to overhaul the state's madrasa teacher recruitment system. Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari announced the decision.
